module: Node "Custom vlua - deprecated" (category `repeat_p_duration`). Old version of "Custom Vehicle Lua": sends the string of the `customLUA` pin to the vehicle `vehId` with `queueLuaCommand`. Obsolete: replaced by "Custom vlua".
notes: The `customLUA` pin is described as "The message that will be displayed. Bug: can not start directly with a number."
`init` reads `self.pinIn.customLUAString` which does not exist (the pin is named `customLUA`): potential error.
No fallback to the player vehicle.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

init.desc: Constructor; tries to copy `pinIn.customLUAString.value` into `data.func` (nonexistent pin).
